choices: a parabola, opening right, with vertex at $(4,-2)$
a parabola, opening right, with vertex at $(-2,4)$

Six cards each have one letter printed on each side of the card. The table below shows the letters that are on each card. (For example, the first card has an A on one side and an M on the other.)

$$\begin{array}{cccccc}\text{A}&\text{A}&\text{A}&\text{A}&\text{Y}&\text{B}\\\text{M}&\text{T}&\text{Y}&\text{C}&\text{C}&\text{T}\end{array}$$

The six cards are tossed into the air and and fall randomly to the ground. What is the probability that the resulting letters can be arranged to spell AMATYC?
